title: Line sketch: Dreams Taking Flight
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A young person with a halo sits in a velvet chair, eyes closed and head tilted upward as butterflies, birds, paper boats, clocks, and floating words emerge from their mouth and fly toward an arched stone window.
